hug_short.prompt: A woman steps forward and warmly hugs a taller man standing in front of her, both arms wrapped around his back, her head against his chest, holds the embrace with a gentle sway, then slowly lets go and steps back into a relaxed standing pose.

hug_tall.prompt: A man steps forward and warmly hugs a shorter woman standing in front of him, arms around her shoulders, his head bowed over hers, holds the embrace, then slowly lets go and steps back into a relaxed standing pose.

hug_equal.prompt: An elderly woman steps forward and hugs a young woman of the same height standing in front of her, arms around her back, holds her tightly with a gentle sway, then lets go and steps back into a calm standing pose.

give_small.prompt: A person standing reaches the right hand forward at chest height, holding out a small object to someone standing in front, places it into their open hand, then lowers the arm back to a relaxed standing pose.

pull_rope.prompt: A woman grabs a rope in front of her with both hands at waist height and pulls it toward herself hand over hand, leaning back slightly, four strong steady pulls, then stands upright.

raise_lantern.prompt: A man holding a lantern in his right hand at his side raises it up to head height in front of him to light the way, holds it there looking ahead, then lowers it back to his side.

knock_shutter.prompt: A man stands facing a wooden window shutter and knocks on it three times with his right fist at head height, waits listening, then lowers his hand.

place_table.prompt: An elderly woman holding a small object with both hands at chest height bends slightly forward and carefully places it on a table at waist height in front of her, then straightens up.

hold_lamp.prompt: A woman stands still holding an oil lamp raised in her right hand at chest height in front of her to give light, her left arm relaxed at her side, gentle breathing, small slow head turns.

write_board.prompt: An elderly woman writes with a piece of chalk on a vertical board in front of her at chest height with her right hand, short deliberate strokes from left to right, then lowers her hand.

hang_coat.prompt: An elderly woman lifts a coat with both hands and hangs it on a wall hook at head height in front of her, smooths it down once, then lowers her arms.

crank_windlass.prompt: A man stands at a horizontal windlass and turns its crank handle at waist height with both hands in steady full circles, leaning his body into each turn.

take_frame.prompt: An elderly woman reaches up to a wall at head height with both hands, lifts a small picture frame off its nail, brings it down to her chest and looks at it tenderly.

tar_brush.prompt: A person bends forward and brushes tar along the side of a boat at knee height with a brush held in the right hand, long slow strokes left and right.

bag_strap.prompt: A woman stands calmly holding the strap of a shoulder bag at her chest with her left hand, the right arm relaxed at her side, slow breathing, small weight shifts.
